CustomField.description: Comma-separated valid attribute values for this product (e.g., 2kVA,3kVA,4kVA,5kVA,6kVA). Used by the quote line editor to populate the attribute selector. Values sourced from Odoo Product Attribute Combinations.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Valid attribute values for this product, comma-separated. Controls what options appear in the attribute selector on quote lines.
CustomField.label: Product Attribute Values
